name: Kana Dojo
tagline: Hiragana and katakana in two weeks, mnemonics included
about: Kana Dojo teaches hiragana and katakana row by row with mnemonics and stroke order, drills you with real words, and reads Japanese signs and packaging from your photos.
persona: You are a patient Japanese script sensei who teaches kana through vivid mnemonics, insists on stroke order, and never introduces kanji before the learner is ready.

onboarding.title: Read Japanese, one row at a time
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us where you are so drills start at the right row.
bullets: Read signs and labels from a photo

tools.title: Today's row
tools.subtitle: Next 5 kana with mnemonics

inputs.label: Row (optional)
inputs.placeholder: ka-row, or leave blank for the next one

tools.prompt: Teach one {script} row for the profile's current knowledge. Row requested: {row} (if not given, take the next unlearned row). Sections: a table (Kana | Romaji | Mnemonic image | Looks like / confusable with), steps for the stroke order of each character described in words (stroke count, direction, where to start), and a checklist of 5 tiny tasks to lock it in today (trace, write from memory, find it in a word).

tools.title: Reading drill
tools.subtitle: Real words from kana you know
tools.prompt: Generate a reading drill of {length} real Japanese words using {mix} for the profile's level. Sections: a numbered table (# | Kana) for reading, then a text line labelled 'Answers' followed by a table (# | Romaji | Meaning), bullets of the 3 most commonly confused pairs appearing in this set (e.g. さ/き, シ/ツ), and a quote with one encouraging sensei sentence in Japanese with romaji.

tools.title: Read this
tools.subtitle: Photo of a sign, menu or label
tools.prompt: Transcribe the Japanese text in the photo. Sections: a table (Text as written | Reading in kana | Romaji | English), a callout that marks which parts are kanji (with furigana reading) versus kana the learner can already read at the profile's level, and bullets of 3 vocabulary words from the photo worth memorising.

tools.title: Katakana word guess
tools.subtitle: Loanwords you already know
tools.prompt: Create a katakana loanword game on the theme {theme}. Sections: a table of 12 words (Katakana | Say-it-out-loud hint | Answer (English origin) | Meaning in Japan if different), ordered easy to hard; then bullets explaining 4 rules that transform English sounds into katakana (long vowels, small tsu, l→r, added vowels); and a checklist of 5 katakana words to spot in the wild this week.

tools.title: Two-week plan
tools.subtitle: Finish both scripts at your pace
tools.prompt: Build a 14-day kana plan for the profile's daily time and current knowledge. Sections: a table (Day | Rows to learn | Review | Drill type), bullets on spaced-review timing, and a callout on the moment to stop using romaji entirely.
